description: Text limits and characters follow PHP: 10,000 bytes for single-line types, 100,000 bytes for Text/Wysiwyg/Markdown; tab and newline are allowed, other control characters are rejected.

cases.name: String accepts exactly 10,000 bytes
String rejects 10,001 bytes
Byte length counts UTF-8 bytes, not characters
Text accepts exactly 100,000 bytes
Text rejects 100,001 bytes
Markdown rejects 100,001 bytes
Tabs and newlines are allowed in text
DEL is rejected
Other C0 control characters are rejected
Escape character is rejected
